tests.name: ubjson_valueless_array_within_limit
tests.intent: Verify that an optimized UBJSON array of nulls within the max valueless container size is successfully read.

tests.name: ubjson_valueless_array_exceed_single_limit
tests.intent: Verify that a single UBJSON array exceeding max_valueless_container_size throws an out_of_range exception.

tests.name: ubjson_multiple_valueless_arrays_cumulative
tests.intent: Verify that multiple small valueless arrays accumulate and are eventually rejected when exceeding the global rate limit.

tests.name: ubjson_noop_array_empty
tests.intent: Verify that an optimized no-op array with a large declared count is parsed as an empty array.

tests.name: ubjson_writer_fallback_valueless
tests.intent: Verify that to_ubjson falls back to unoptimized form when valueless elements exceed the threshold.

tests.name: ubjson_boolean_true_array_limit
tests.intent: Verify handling of optimized arrays of true booleans ('T').

tests.name: ubjson_boolean_false_array_limit
tests.intent: Verify handling of optimized arrays of false booleans ('F').

tests.name: ubjson_sax_noop_parsing
tests.intent: Verify SAX parser behavior for no-op arrays reports start_array(0).

tests.name: ubjson_roundtrip_fallback
tests.intent: Verify that data written by to_ubjson with fallback can be successfully read back.

tests.name: bjdata_valueless_array_rejection
tests.intent: Verify that BJData handles valueless typed arrays differently or rejects them.

tests.name: ubjson_charge_saturation_test
tests.intent: Verify charge_valueless_elements overflow/saturation resilience with extreme inputs.

tests.name: ubjson_unoptimized_array_nulls
tests.intent: Verify parsing of unoptimized arrays of nulls.

tests.name: ubjson_writer_exact_threshold
tests.intent: Verify to_ubjson behavior right at the max_valueless_container_size threshold.

tests.name: ubjson_empty_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of an empty basic UBJSON array.

tests.name: ubjson_nested_valueless_arrays
tests.intent: Verify nesting multiple optimized valueless arrays.

tests.name: ubjson_mixed_typed_array
tests.intent: Verify an optimized array with integer types which carry payloads.

tests.name: ubjson_object_with_valueless
tests.intent: Verify objects containing valueless markers or structures.

tests.name: ubjson_invalid_count_size
tests.intent: Verify error handling when count specifier is truncated or invalid.

tests.name: ubjson_multiple_distinct_types
tests.intent: Verify sequential valueless arrays of different types (Z, T, F).

tests.name: ubjson_writer_multiple_calls
tests.intent: Verify to_ubjson maintains accumulated valueless count across separate arrays in a larger structure.
